title: SC 10 · EXT. FORECOURT - THE RUINS - CONTINUOUS

shots.sound: Engines, steady. Stone grinding against stone.
shots.camText: Wide · 32 mm · eye 1.6 m, up 7° · square to the arch, 68 m · locked-off
shots.note: The people who survived the fall are about to be crushed by what is left of it.

shots.sound: Under the engines, nothing marks the flashes; the count is silent and exact.
shots.camText: Medium-wide · 35 mm · Liora's shoulder 1.2 m, up 9° · 2.3 m behind her right shoulder · locked-off
shots.note: White returns, in her hand: the count her city lived by.

shots.sound: Inside the hull: a hush, the engines as a hum through the floor. Her voice level and procedural; the last t released on the beat.
shots.camText: Hand template · 40 mm · 1.0 m behind her hand · her side of the glass, 40 m up, looking down · locked-off
shots.note: Open: another protects. The same frame as 3.4 and 6.3, and it is not his hand.

shots.sound: One bell note, long; under it the engines drop away for its length.
shots.camText: Wide · 24 mm · the boy's eye 1.0 m, up 10° · 40 m from the arch · locked-off
shots.note: Rescue from a stranger: the same miracle as the held stone, with someone else's hand.

shots.sound: Engines layering, one pitch over another.
shots.camText: Wide · 32 mm · eye 1.7 m · among the army, behind the captain · locked-off
shots.note: The sky held open in scene 2 begins to fill.

shots.sound: The engines as a floor; the bell's tail; her breath.
shots.camText: Close · wrist template (3.5) · 50 mm · Liora's eye line 1.4 m · 1.6 m from the wrist · shallow · long hold
shots.note: Far: she sees him small, and her own hand covers the place he held.

shots.camText: Long-lens POV · 135 mm · Cael's eye 1.75 m · 70 m to the arch · locked-off
shots.note: His look matches hers at 6.5: the long lens is how these two see each other.

shots.sound: The engines; his breathing, uneven; the binding creaking with each tremor.
shots.camText: Close · wrist template, his side · 50 mm · hand height 1.0 m · 1.6 m from the hand · shallow · locked-off
shots.note: Far: his hand stays clear and shakes in front of her, so we see that he knows her.

shots.sound: Engines. No score. The captain's voice level and plain.
shots.camText: Medium two-shot in profile · 40 mm · eye 1.75 m · 4.5 m from the pair, lens down the road · locked-off
shots.note: The road out is right there between them, and the captain will not let him take it.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: You do not get to stop now.

shots.sound: Engines. The leather of the binding creaks as the fist closes.
shots.camText: Hand template · 40 mm · 1.0 m behind his hand · level · locked-off
shots.note: Closed: war. The last of the four hands, and the only one that does not hold anything up.

shots.sound: Engines; his voice quiet, not shouted.
shots.camText: Medium · 50 mm · eye 1.75 m · in front of him, on his centre line · locked-off
shots.note: Symmetry when Cael commands: the line lands on the look, as the bible stages it.

shots.sound: Cloth cracking open in the wind; his cry, alone; nothing answers for a beat.
shots.camText: Medium-wide · 40 mm · eye 1.6 m · side-on to the standard-bearer, 12 m · locked-off
shots.note: He wanted to be told it was worth it; now he is told to fight.

shots.sound: The cry taken up voice after voice, uneven. No score: the voices are the music.
shots.camText: Long-lens wide · 85 mm · eye 1.6 m on a rubble block · 6 m past the end of the line · locked-off

shots.sound: Thirteen mechanical clacks, one per housing, over the engines.
shots.camText: Wide · 50 mm · eye 1.6 m, up 25° · among the rear ranks · locked-off
shots.note: The fire comes back, on the other side.

shots.sound: The cry dies away by 4.0. Then only engines, swelling into the cut.
shots.camText: Extreme wide · 32 mm · eye 1.6 m on the gate rubble · in the broken gate, 65 m behind Cael · locked-off
shots.note: The sky he was given in scene 2 is full.

shots.sound: The lock, enormous and dry. Silence. One deep engine stroke, left to ring out.
shots.camText: Black · the lock · the title · one engine stroke
shots.note: The pulse, which began in the foundry, belongs to the fleet now.
